title: Continuity packs, characters và consent
scope_items: Database Migration 00015: Created consent_records, characters, continuity_packs, continuity_pack_versions with composite workspace tenant keys, PostgreSQL row-level security enabled and forced, narrow grants, composite foreign keys, and uq_characters_single_default partial unique index.

Acceptance Target 1 (Revoked consent blocks generation): Likeness consent record verification with fail-closed preflight check (CheckGenerationConsent) preventing video generation when consent is missing or revoked; face match verification validation; immediate generation blockage upon consent revocation.

Acceptance Target 2 (Pack updates retain old lineage): Continuity pack updates create immutable version records (versionIndex incremented) preserving snapshot references, rules, and reason while keeping prior version history fully intact and traversable.

Acceptance Target 3 (Only one default character): Strict workspace invariant ensuring at most one active default character. Designating a character as default atomically unsets default on all other characters in the workspace at both the database level (partial unique index) and API/store layers.
Character Slot Quota Gating (RULE-M08-003): Enforced slot caps per tier (Free: 1, Starter: 2, Pro: 5, Business: 15, Enterprise: unlimited). Archiving characters frees slots.
4-Step Character Wizard: Type selection -> Profile setup -> Model preview -> Save & Canonical Pack initialization (AC-M08-001, AC-M08-002).
Web & Mobile UI Surfaces: Full Svelte 5 web implementation (W019 Continuity OS and W037 Studio Character Library) and Flutter mobile implementation (MobileCharacterLibraryView).
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_RevokedConsentBlocksGeneration (Go -race), Vitest unit tests (web), and Flutter unit/widget tests confirm fail-closed consent verification and generation blockage on revocation.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_PackUpdatesRetainOldLineage (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm immutable pack version snapshots and historical lineage retention.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_OnlyOneDefaultCharacter (Go -race), PostgreSQL partial unique index uq_characters_single_default, Svelte 5 components, and Flutter tests confirm single default character invariance.
Migration 00015 Verified: migrator_test.go passes all live PostgreSQL RLS isolation, composite foreign key write attack tests, and rollback tests for migration 00015.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, Dart analyze/test.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: check_node.sh (svelte-check 0/0, vite build, 138 web tests + 6 admin tests, web smoke SSR 200) and check_flutter.sh (flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings + 121 tests) all pass.
notes: Delivered M08 Continuity OS foundational layer: versioned packs, references, character setup, consent and slot gating. Production preview completed in P4.
